entries.name: HRD_API_TOKEN
entries.description: A MyHRD API token. The public MyHRD API only reads report data and report validity, so the token can do nothing else.
howToGet: Sign in to MyHRD at my.hrdantwerp.com and open API Access in the page footer.
Fill in the request form; HRD checks it and emails the token within one to three working days.
Put it straight into the instance's Railway variables. Never send it by chat or email.

entries.name: HRD_REPORT_NUMBERS_FILE
entries.description: A text or CSV file of the HRD report numbers to look up, one per line in the first column, such as the report numbers on the business's stones and jewels. Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped. Never inside a git repo.
howToGet: Export the report number column for HRD-graded stones and jewels from the POS or inventory system.
Save it outside any git repo and put its path here. Add new numbers to the end; each is looked up once.

entries.name: HRD_MAX_LOOKUPS_PER_SYNC
entries.description: The most report numbers one sync looks up. HRD allows 1000 lookups a day and 100 requests in 15 minutes, so the rest wait for the next sync. Defaults to 50.
howToGet: Keep it under 100, HRD's limit for 15 minutes.
